name: Memory station victory
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: final cinematic background illustration for an animated memory-game result banner, appropriate for children around age 8.
Input image: the supplied local image is a STYLE AND SETTING REFERENCE ONLY, not an edit target. Use its polished titanium orbital research station, circular structural ring, cylindrical central hub, cyan technology, warm window lights, blue planet and deep navy space. Do not reproduce the foreground memory cards, foreground platform or reference's off-center cropping.
Primary request: Create ONE final opaque landscape illustration, target 1536 x 1024 pixels, aspect ratio 3:2. This is a complete polished scene for later animation, not a UI mockup.
Shared station design and camera: A complete circular orbital research station made of brushed silver/titanium and navy metal, a broad annular ring with windows, evenly arranged radial spokes, a cylindrical central reactor hub and restrained vertical communications structures. Use the same station form, materials and camera direction as the provided setting reference. Show a gently elevated three-quarter view, the station ring appearing as an ellipse and the central hub clearly visible. Moderately wide view, no extreme lens or dramatic skew.
Precise composition: The station is centered horizontally; its central reactor is at approximately 50% image width and 46% image height. Keep the ENTIRE main station silhouette within the central 65% of the image, approximately x 18–82% and y 14–79%, with clear dark negative space near the edges. No part of the station is clipped. A blue planet curves BELOW and behind it, with deep navy orbital space above. The scene must stay readable when cropped into a 600 x 290 result banner or a centered mobile view. Prioritize clean large silhouettes and premium immersive depth.
Style/medium: Cinematic polished friendly premium 3D sci-fi rendering, convincing tactile station materials, beautiful controlled illumination and atmospheric orbital depth. Rich navy, cyan and amber palette, high artwork quality and clean focal hierarchy.
Constraints: Background scene only. No title, text, letters, numbers, logos, UI, frames, overlay graphics, split panels, cards or foreground game controls. No people required. No weapons, violence, horror, explosions, fire, wreckage, damage, corpses, scary faces, distressing elements or fireworks. Fully opaque output; no transparency required. ONE final image.
Specific scene: VICTORY, the station has successfully rebooted. The central reactor at 50% width and 46% height shines bright cyan-white and is unmistakably the BRIGHTEST focal point. The entire complete ring is steadily illuminated with cyan and warm golden window lights. Beautiful coherent energy flows along its radial spokes toward and around the restored reactor. A hopeful soft golden sunrise glows behind the lower blue planet, kept subordinate in brightness to the reactor. A few tiny golden light particles naturally surround the station. The station is fully functional, stable and intact. Celebratory but controlled glow, hopeful wonder and a calm sense of accomplishment. Do not add explosive effects, fireworks or random bright exterior machinery. Preserve clear station geometry under the lighting.
